result.topic_en: A page of mixed notes: a remark on magnets and iron, the isoperimetric-type statement that a semicircle encloses a given area with minimal perimeter about a straight line, a divisibility argument for ll+mm by 2, and a note on arranging the digit rows of an infinite series so that columns give binomial coefficients, with a related expansion of (1+y)^p.
